description: Roads of Nepal is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OSGeo Nepal. All roads, highways, and streets across Nepal. Combines OpenStreetMap with TomTom road geometry (via Overture Maps). Coverage: Nepal. The portal files it under the publisher OSGeo Nepal. Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 7 resource(s) in GEOPACKAGE, HTML, JSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
